sources.title: en_core_web_sm: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview en_core_web_sm is a general-purpose English NLP pipeline from spacy optimized for CPU inference. Version 3.7.1 runs on spaCy >=3.7.2,<3.8.0 and bundles seven components: tok2vec for word vector encoding, tagger for part-of-speech tagging, parser for dependency parsing, senter for sentence segmentation, ner for named entity recognition, attribute_ruler for rule-based attribute ...
